en: Color-tinted postcard showing a gently rolling rural landscape with fields, trees, a stream or path in the foreground, and several farmhouses with red or brown roofs scattered across the middle distance. The horizon is flat and expansive, typical of lowland countryside. At the bottom margin, there is printed Dutch text identifying the location near Nijmegen and a smaller line of text naming the specific valley. A printer's credit appears on the right, and there is a handwritten signature and date on the lower right.
